Foiley 1.0 brings faster Studio previews and plots and reduces work in viscous 2D sweeps. The same executable provides Foiley Studio, the command line, and XFoil-compatible scripting.

## What changed

- Airfoil sampling prepares the surface splines once per batch. Sampling 121 stations on NACA 2412 went from 584 to 17 microseconds in the local release benchmark.
- Plane Design reuses its foil database and preview mesh key across repaints. On the 4,178-triangle PW5 fixture, that avoided 1.31 ms of database and key computation per repaint.
- The Newton solver reuses the mass-influence matrix between iterations while its inputs remain valid. The 77-point NACA 2412 sweep at Reynolds number 300,000 ran about 2% faster. All 3,955 stored operating points in the regression comparison matched the preceding Foiley build bit for bit.
- Studio borrows completed 3D results and copies scalar plot values for running jobs. In a synthetic 100-point polar, the plots avoided 4.9 MB of pressure-data copies per repaint.
